Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän toiminta ja kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. The dynamic purchasing system will remain valid until the end of 2033, unless the contracting entity shortens or extends the duration of the system. During the duration of the dynamic purchasing system, all interested candidates may submit a request for participation. The operation and scope of the dynamic purchasing system are described in more detail in the invitation to participate and its attachments. According to the preliminary estimate, dozens of procurements will be carried out within the dynamic purchasing system over the coming years. The total value of the procurements is estimated to be 26 000 000 EUR during the entire duration of the DPS for comprehensive service procurements. The dynamic purchasing system is designed to address procurement needs in the coming years, with a sufficient amount to achieve the objectives.
